project_type: pnpm + Turborepo TypeScript monorepo; Next.js 15 App Router web app in apps/web
build_system: Root pnpm@11.21.0 scripts invoke Vitest and Turbo. Web package uses Next.js with a prebuild script that runs scripts/generate-version.mjs and writes apps/web/public/version.json.
test_framework: Vitest 3 from the repository root; existing focused tests are under apps/web/lib/__tests__.
verification_instructions: Run focused converter, prompt, parser, authoring-helper, and undo tests first; run pnpm --filter @quiz-creator/web typecheck; run pnpm --filter @quiz-creator/web build; finish with pnpm vitest run. Browser verification is required for paste event propagation, rich-text/native undo, and the meaning of the reported term field.
snapshot_or_generated_files: The web build prebuild step generates apps/web/public/version.json and Next generates apps/web/.next; avoid unrelated generated churn and follow existing tracking conventions.
environment_constraints: Windows PowerShell workspace at c:\Users\User\IntelliJ\quiz-creator. Do not touch unrelated pre-existing changes, especially apps/web/hooks/useQuizSession.ts. SmolLM2 is optional, client-only, bounded, and must not overwrite later user edits.
contribution_requirements: Read current source before editing; keep deterministic conversion free of LLM/API calls; use explicit paste boundaries instead of ordinary typing interception; preserve native undo where possible; commit locally on the branch and never push.
key_patterns: convertToQuestion is pure and consumed by apps/web/lib/clipboardQuestionPrompt.ts. parseSmartClipboard returns single_pair, bulk_terms, question_answer, question_answers, or enumeration_blocks. ManualQuizCreator intercepts rich question and identification answer paste plus a container bulk-import handler. QuizQuestionFormModal intercepts rich question and answer-field paste. RichTextEditor already handles Ctrl+Z/Ctrl+Y with document.execCommand and forwards onPaste. Existing tests cover converter, prompt, and parser behavior but not component runtime events.
directory_structure: apps/web/lib contains deterministic parsers, prompt builders, and unit tests; apps/web/lib/ai contains optional local SmolLM2 fallback; apps/web/components/quiz contains manual creation, add/edit modal, overview, and question list; apps/web/components/editor contains contentEditable editor and native undo toolbar; packages/core contains deterministic transformation services.
